text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hi, Trainer! I received a lovely<n>invitation to a special
event today, and<n>you're coming with me!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: No time for questions! Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, and thank you both for<n>coming. It's a
pleasure to have you<n>here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I find myself at one of the prestigious<n>Mejiro
family's tea parties. Being<n>suddenly dragged into
such an<n>exquisite atmosphere is enough to<n>make
anyone nervous...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hi there, Dober! Thanks for inviting us<n>today!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Oh, not at all! Please enjoy<n>yourselves!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I never would've thought<n>you'd invite Pearl,
Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Well, she joined me for some partner<n>running the
other day, so this is my<n>way of saying thanks.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I heard from Dober that you often<n>hold tea parties
like this, so I asked<n>her if I could attend one!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I see! Well, the tea that Dober<n>brews tastes
great, so you're in for a<n>treat! Go ahead and enjoy
a cup!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, this is just heavenly! What a<n>fantastic cup of
tea! And such rich<n>flavor... Is this Assam?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad it suits your palate. And<n>you're correct.
Today's blend is an<n>Assam milk tea.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
In truth, Dober selected all the tea<n>blends and
accompanying desserts<n>for today's gathering.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Might I suggest you give the<n>chocolate truffles a
try? They're<n>delightfully rich and milky.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh! They really are excellent! And<n>this buttery
financier goes so well<n>with the rich Assam tea!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: So what were you up to last<n>weekend, Palmer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I hit up a driving range. I was<n>hoping to increase
my distance, but<n>things didn't really pan out...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I bet you'd have better luck if you<n>really put some
oomph behind your<n>swing and gave the ball a good
whack!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you know how to golf, Pearl?! I<n>want to
increase my driving distance,<n>so do you think you
could give me<n>some pointers?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two of them step outside into the<n>garden to
practice golf swings. I'm a<n>little puzzled, though,
since I don't<n>recall Seeking the Pearl ever
mentioning being into golf...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I've got my club face positioning<n>down, but I just
can't seem to<n>increase the club head speed...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
If you want to increase the speed,<n>you just need to
swing with all your<n>might!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Strike it boldly with explosive<n>strength, and
ka-ching! You've hit a<n>home run!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I see. So the explosiveness of my<n>downswing is
the key, huh? And I'll<n>need to build up my arm
muscles to<n>increase my swing strength!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
If you want to beef up and increase<n>your explosive
power, I recommend<n>you do some antagonistic
training!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Take your arms, for example. You<n>need to
strengthen both your biceps<n>and their antagonistic
pair, your<n>triceps, to get the most from your<n>training!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
In other words, it's more beneficial to<n>train them as
a set, like how ordering<n>a combo meal is more cost
effective<n>than ordering a single burger! It just
makes more sense!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yup! That's the most efficient way to<n>train!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Training your antagonistic muscles<n>will improve the
overall stability and<n>flexibility of your main working
muscles, so your explosive power<n>will skyrocket!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Extraordinary! The muscular system<n>holds so many
possibilities!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You could say that again! Wow, I<n>never imagined
you'd understand the<n>appeal of muscles so well,
Pearl!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I somehow doubt she's exactly on<n>the same page
as the others... but<n>everyone seems to be enjoying
the<n>conversation just fine.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And what about you, Trainer?! What<n>do you think
about the latent potential<n>within biceps?!
choice_data_list: I-I guess it might be infinite?!

Train them enough, and you could even defeat a
gorilla one day!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Of course! That's exactly right! There<n>are infinite
possibilities out there!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! All right, I'm going to push my<n>biceps to their
very limits!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: No, Ryan, there are no limits! Let'spush ourselves forever into the greatunknown!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You're right! Let's get right to it, then!<n>We can start
with dumbbells!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's just what I was thinking!<n>Let's get big and
buff!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before I realize it, the tea party has<n>turned into a
bodybuilder's club. At<n>least everyone seems to be
having a<n>great time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm just about to brush it off as a<n>joke, but I don't
get the chance<n>before Seeking the Pearl jumps in.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
What an eccentric idea, Trainer! I<n>expected no less
from you!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'm going train until I get strong<n>enough to take
down a gorilla! And<n>once I do, I'm going to wrestle
one<n>for real!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha, how's that for an interesting<n>challenge?
Let's head to the zoo and<n>see if they'll agree to set
up such a<n>battle for us!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
W-wait a minute, Pearl! That's too<n>reckless of a
proposal!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The challenge Seeking the Pearl<n>suggests is far too
dangerous, so<n>Mejiro Dober and I both desperately
try to reel in her ambitions.
